body.purpose: Agent commentary, prompts, and assistant answers.

label.purpose: State, elapsed time, tool names, and disclosure labels.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Chevron, focus, and disclosure state feedback.

narrative.overview: A neutral, answer-first conversation surface with quiet process narration and explicit attention states.

rules.name: The Attention Rarity Rule
rules.body: Saturated color is reserved for focus, selection, required action, warning, failure, and confirmed success.

rules.name: The Flat Transcript Rule
rules.body: Routine progress is not wrapped in cards; bounded panels are reserved for interaction, recovery, and details.

dos: Auto-surface states that require user attention.
Reuse OpenWebUI controls and theme tokens.
donts: Do not create a status dashboard inside the message.
Do not use nested cards, glass surfaces, neon gradients, or decorative motion.
Do not expose private reasoning or raw protocol fields.
